title: Groin Pain in Athletes (Adductor-related, Inguinal-related and Pubic-related)
case: Presentation (from the chapter): Where exactly? Point with one finger: Entity. Kicking, sprinting, cutting?: Load mechanism. Pain with coughing or sneezing?: Inguinal-related. Deep groin clicking, catching, pain with sitting?: Hip-related
working: Groin Pain in Athletes (Adductor-related, Inguinal-related and Pubic-related)

differentials.name: Femoral neck stress fracture
differentials.key: Runner, pain with impact, hop test painful, night pain

qa: Which entity is most common? Adductor-related.
Why measure squeeze force? It gives an objective baseline and return-to-sport marker.
A runner has groin pain on hopping. What do you suspect? Femoral neck stress fracture.
What is the key prevention exercise? Copenhagen adduction.
Pain with coughing and resisted sit-up, no adductor signs? Inguinal-related groin pain.

redFlags.Finding: Groin pain with pain on hopping in an endurance athlete or female athlete with low energy availability
Fever, severe pain on any hip movement
Child or adolescent with groin or knee pain and limp

manualNotes: Manual therapy has a minor role (soft-tissue work for comfort). Exercise is the core:

The Copenhagen adduction exercise has been shown to reduce groin problems in football as a prevention program [Ref – to verify]. Active strengthening programs have stronger support than passive treatment [Ref – to verify].
